verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI documents an official CLI, `clai`, but it is for chatting with LLMs, serving a browser chat UI, or launching an existing Agent in CLI mode. No evidence shows a command or official template that scaffolds a new agent project. That CLI is an adjacent feature and earns no credit for project scaffolding.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have a coding agent scaffold a new agent project from an official CLI or template in one command
